rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the ability to act first or without being prompted.

example.english: You can't just wait to be told what to do; you need initiative.
example.traditional: 做嘢唔可以淨係等人吩咐，要有主動性。
example.jyutping: zou6 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 dang2 jan4 fan1 fu3 jiu3 jau5 zyu2 dung6 sing3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on acting independently or voluntarily rather than waiting for instructions.

example.english: These residents showed great initiative and came to help without being asked.
example.traditional: 呢班街坊好有自發性，冇人叫都走嚟幫手。
example.jyutping: ne1 baan1 gaai1 fong1 hou2 jau5 zi6 faat3 sing3 mou5 jan4 giu3 dou1 zau2 lai4 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this when initiative is being discussed as a person's willingness and drive to get involved and take action.

example.english: The new colleague shows a lot of initiative and helps out immediately whenever needed.
example.traditional: 新同事做嘢好有積極性，一有需要就即刻幫手。
example.jyutping: san1 tung4 si6 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 zik1 gik6 sing3 jat1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 zau6 zik1 hak1 bong1 sau2
